about: The nation-creation wheels. Edit freely: slice labels (and an optional "short" one for the retro wheel), blurbs, weights (higher = more likely; 0 = never), ranges, name parts and screen text. Reload the page to see changes. Number wheels (those with an "estimate") show each slice's range on the wheel, written with the estimate's "range" pattern; the result is a number drawn from that range. Their labels (Small, Rich...) are names for the data file and are not shown.

panel.about: Which wheels the small nation panel on the map shows (by wheel id). The creation record shows them all.

names.about: Nation names are a title (picked by government) with a made-up place name in it. {place} is replaced by the place name.

place.about: A place name is a start + sometimes a middle + an end, e.g. Var + nia = Varnia.

text.about: Words shown on the wheel screen, nation card and nation panel.
